# DigiInnov Case Lab

> A gamified platform where students and founders learn digital innovation by doing — real business cases, a startup simulator, an AI mentor, and a bilingual (EN/BG) innovation dictionary.

DigiInnov Case Lab teaches digital innovation and entrepreneurship through a Learn → Apply → Have Fun loop: interactive case studies, a build-measure-learn startup simulator, a guided "My Startup" project (Business Model Canvas), and gamified progression (XP, levels, badges).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the platform, learning journey, and how it works.
- [About](/about): What digital innovation is and how the platform teaches it.
- [Innovation basics](/innovation-basics): Introduction to core innovation concepts.
- [Dictionary](/dictionary): Bilingual (English/Bulgarian) glossary of innovation, startup, and business terms.
